run_fit_linear_references: run the fit_references script with a config yaml to fit and save element linear references
run_fit_references_cli: run the fit_references CLI with --config and --out-path arguments to fit linear references from a dataset
fit_linref_function: fit linear element references from a training dataset using a config dict and save checkpoints
load_config_yaml: load a YAML configuration file and detect duplicate keys using load_config
save_element_reference_checkpoint: save fitted element reference state dicts as checkpoint files using save_checkpoint
